cover.sub: EVERY STEP FROM MILITARY TO MASTERY

slides.title: THE BASICS
rules: 8 per gun, unlocked just by leveling the weapon (Han 86: level 10 to 65).
3 challenges per gun. Finish one and you can use that camo on every weapon.

guns.name: Gold
guns.desc: All 8 Military + 3 Special, then 15 kills in one MP match (100 in DMZ).

guns.name: Platinum
guns.desc: Gold on every gun in the class, then a class challenge (ARs: 50 headshots).

guns.name: Harmonic Break
guns.desc: Platinum on all 33 weapons, then a class challenge (ARs: 25 double kills).

guns.name: Divergence
guns.desc: You get it for 33 Harmonic Break challenges. Opens Mastery.

guns.name: Mercurial Drift
guns.desc: Get 10 kills in a match, 250 times.

guns.name: Polyatomic Reforged
guns.desc: Get 3 kills without taking damage, 300 times.

guns.name: Ripple Tide
guns.desc: Exfil with 2 Lieutenant dog tags in one deployment, 50 times.

guns.name: Helio
guns.desc: Get 25,000 kills with Legendary weapons on a max-level Operator.

slides.title: WARZONE

guns.name: Parallax
guns.desc: Get 5 kills in a match, 300 times.

guns.name: Empyros
guns.desc: Place top 5 with at least 6 kills, 75 times.

slides.foot: WARZONE MASTERY COUNTS WITH ANY WEAPON

slides.title: PYROCLAST

guns.name: Pyroclast Terminus
guns.desc: Reach max level in Weapon Prestige 1.

slides.foot: PRESTIGING A WEAPON KEEPS ALL YOUR CAMOS

slides.title: 3 THINGS TO KNOW
rules: Multiplayer, DMZ and (since Season 1) Warzone share one camo grind. Finish a challenge in any mode.
AI kills count in DMZ, so the targets are higher: Gold is 15 kills in MP but 100 in DMZ.
Each mode has its own 3 mastery camos. They only open after Divergence.
